ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated against the pinned SHA-256; the single printed page marker and both editorial footnotes are preserved.
The source's chapter numbering is irregular (two chapter 2 entries, two chapter 12 entries, and a deleted <11)>); English preserves the sequence instead of renumbering it.

выставляют окна refers to the spring removal/opening of the double window frames in the Youth material; English uses 'The window frames are taken out' rather than the misleading literal 'windows are displayed'.

The audited Markdown and official volume 2 electronic transcription both show the damaged-looking sequence 'сч с ія' after 'добродетели и'. Context and the visible letter pattern strongly indicate счастия; English renders 'virtue and happiness' while recording the source anomaly rather than silently treating the digital string as clean.

The telegraphic 'Жестокость Володи, к кот. я сам не знаю, что делаю' is kept close as 'Volodya's cruelty; toward him I myself do not know what I am doing' without inventing the missing syntactic relation.
помещичества is rendered 'life as a landowner'; юнкер is retained as the historical military term 'junker'.
The manuscript's angle-bracket alternatives/deletions, [1 illegible] marker, and the pencil-note apparatus are represented.
